title: Transformer architecture to large foundation-model systems
sourceNativeSummary: Sequence modeling was dominated by recurrent/convolutional architectures. The 2017 Transformer replaced recurrence/convolution in the core sequence-transduction architecture with attention and enabled highly parallel training; later large multimodal models combined model scaling with massive compute, data, evaluation and alignment systems.
rivalOrBoundary: The trajectory is not “one paper caused AI”; architecture, accelerator infrastructure, scaling practice, data, evaluation, deployment and feedback co-evolved.
